g.text: Owners report it. Nobody acts on it.
The unrecalled gap: failures owners keep reporting that no recall, investigation or settlement covers.
2021–23 Jeep Wrangler "death wobble": 380 complaints in model years nothing covers.
Counts: NHTSA complaint and investigation flat files, 2025 (our count).
DOT OIG audit ST2023031: 26 of 27 sampled investigations missed their deadlines.
